# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the default branch is supported; fixes land there.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately to the `security_contact` named in `.agent-setup/service.yaml`,
or through GitHub private vulnerability reporting where this repository has it
enabled. Do not open a public issue.

Expect a first response within 5 working days.

## Secrets

No secret is ever committed to this repository. A secret found in its history is
treated as leaked: revoke it first, then report it as above.
